note: Range-and-habitat surfaces, certified by scripts/build-range-habitat-surfaces.mjs. Separate from the other registries so no builder can erase another's surfaces.

confidence.rule: A categorical habitat profile inside a range from occurrence records: MODERATE from 1000 records in 100 squares, LIMITED below (570 records, 22 squares).

visualTransform.statedAs: Colour is the habitat class, not a rank: red core, orange and yellow strong, green moderate, blue marginal; a cell of mixed cover takes its share-weighted class.

surfaces.unit: habitat class inside the supported range
surfaces.effectiveResolutionStatedAs: Land cover per 0.1° cell (about 11 km); the range edge comes from records within 25 km, so it is coarser than the habitat inside it
